settings.heading: The critics are clucking about Clover

settings.quote: “Clover’s worries will feel familiar to many readers, and through her gentle moments of uncertainty and self-discovery, her quiet optimism and determination make her an endearing character to follow. […] A charming farmyard story about finding the courage to embrace who you are.”

settings.heading: Watch Clover's story come to life
settings.text: Trying to be like the other animals on the farm leaves Clover feeling a little lost. But when an unexpected storm changes everything, she discovers that the qualities that make her unique are exactly what make her special.

settings.title: Builds confidence
settings.text: Encourages self-belief and shows kids that being themselves is their superpower.

settings.heading: Hi! I'm Melanie.
settings.text:
I'm a writer and farm-loving mom who lives on a little patch of land with my family and animals (including a flock of spirited chickens!). Inspired by my son and everyday moments in the countryside, I wrote Clover, the Brave Chicken to celebrate courage, curiosity, and the quiet strength that lives inside every child.

I'm a big believer in muddy boots, bedtime stories, and raising kids to be both kind and brave. Thank you for supporting my dreams with Clover!

settings.question: What ages is Clover for?
settings.answer: Clover, the Brave Chicken is written for ages 3–5. Toddlers as young as two love the rhymes and pointing out all the farm animals, too!

settings.question: What's the book like?
settings.answer: It's a premium 8.5 × 8.5 inch hardcover with 24 pages of full-color, hand-drawn illustrations and a playful rhyming story that's made for reading aloud.

settings.question: Is shipping really free?
settings.answer: Yes! Shipping is free on all books. You'll see your delivery options at checkout.

settings.question: Can I get it personalized and signed?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Tick “Personalize & sign it by the author” when you add the book to your cart and tell us who it's for, and Melanie will sign it with a personal inscription.

settings.question: How do I get the free activity packet?
settings.answer: Every purchase comes with a free 10-page printable activity packet (coloring, tracing, mazes, counting and more). You can also grab it right now by joining Clover's Club with your email.

settings.question: Is it good for classrooms and libraries?
settings.answer: Teachers love Clover for circle time. The story sparks conversations about courage, kindness and what makes each of us unique, and the free discussion sheet makes it easy to use in class.
